title: Gala
description: A cinematic project presentation built around paced storytelling.

details.overview: Gala pairs motion and framing to introduce a brand moment without burying the message under decoration.
details.challenge: Cinematic launches often prioritize spectacle over clarity, leaving the core message hard to retain.
details.solution: Paced storytelling, deliberate framing, and restrained UI chrome keep the narrative readable while still feeling premium.
features: Responsive framing for mobile and desktop
